comment: Pasos de agent_pool_warmup / agentPoolWarmup (ai-agent-fast-start) que ambos SDKs deben producir; timeout en segundos (TS: timeoutMs = x1000, o ausente si el paso usa el valor por defecto).

steps.cmd:
set -u
mkdir -p '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode'
umask 077 && head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 > '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/serve.secret'
OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD="$(cat '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/serve.secret')" OPENCODE_CONFIG='/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/opencode.json' OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1 OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1 OPENCODE_DISABLE_LSP_DOWNLOAD=1 OPENCODE_DISABLE_DEFAULT_PLUGINS=1 OPENCODE_PURE=1 OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE=1 exec opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4096

set -u
mkdir -p '/home/user/.rayito/agent/warm'
until [ -s '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/serve.secret' ] && curl -fsS -m 5 -u "opencode:$(cat '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/serve.secret')" 'http://127.0.0.1:4096/global/health' >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  sleep 0.5
done
curl -fsS -m 5 -u "opencode:$(cat '/home/user/.rayito/agent/opencode/serve.secret')" 'http://127.0.0.1:4096/config?directory=%2Fhome%2Fuser%2F.rayito%2Fagent%2Fwarm' >/dev/null
